optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume, work sample, and notes establish the candidate’s experience with CI infrastructure, Go tooling, build reporting, and graduate mentoring, but do not provide evidence of runbook creation for developer-tooling incidents.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review required to assess fit based on evidence gaps.

evidence.text: Platform engineer at Vantor Labs (code-search software), January 2020 to present, maintaining the CI build infrastructure and remote cache for a monorepo of about four million lines.
Added a troubleshooting page for the remote cache to the team wiki, covering cache misses after base-image changes and how to clear a poisoned cache entry safely.

Written reference (former engineering manager, identity checked by the recruiter against the company directory): the candidate was the assigned mentor for three engineers in the 2023 graduate scheme, held weekly pairing sessions with each of them and signed off their on-call readiness checklists in October 2023.
Built a Go command-line tool that lets engineers reproduce CI failures locally with the same container image and environment variables as the pipeline.

hiringEvidencePacket.auditSummary: The candidate’s resume and work sample provide strong evidence for most platform engineering responsibilities, including CI infrastructure maintenance, Go tooling, build reporting, and graduate mentoring.
